description: Land Title Registration Department - Walagama, Rideegama D/S Division, Kurunegala District - C. M. No. 420129
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 73, Block 01) with detailed land particulars including location, extent, owner information, and title classification. The content falls under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land registrations and title determinations.
